question: What is the meaning of life cycle assessment (lca) in relation to sustainability?
description:
Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) is an analytical methodology used to analyze and quantify the environmental aspects and impacts of product systems, such as materials, products, processes, buildings, over their life cycle. It is used for product development and improvement, as well as strategic planning, public policy making, and marketing, to support sustainability. <|ENDINPUT>

Question: How does the life cycle assessment (lca) methodology contribute to the sustainability of product systems? <|ANSWER|>Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) methodology contributes to the sustainability of product systems by analyzing and quantifying their environmental aspects and impacts over their life cycle. This helps in identifying areas for improvement and supports sustainable product development, strategic planning, public policy making, and marketing. <|ENDINPUT>
